request.description:
Verify transaction is created when application is accepted (this was created before Escrow Integration, this step is not longer needed)

**Post** [http://localhost:8080/api/transactions/commit](http://localhost:8080**/api/transactions/commit)  
**Headers:**

Content-Type: application/json

**Body: raw json**

{  
"jobId": 1,  
"customerId": 2,  
"providerId": 3,  
"amount": 100.00  
}

**Expected Response (200 OK):**

{  
"transactionId": 1,  
"status": "COMMITTED",  
"amount": 100.00,  
"committedAt": "2024-12-22T10:30:00",  
"inProgressAt": null,  
"completedAt": null,  
"confirmedAt": null,  
"disputedAt": null,  
"resolvedAt": null  
}

Provider Starts Work: Verify provider can mark work as IN_PROGRESS

POST [http://localhost:8080/api/transactions/{{transactionId}}/start](http://localhost:8080/api/transactions/{{transactionId}}/start)

Authorization: Bearer {{providerToken}}

**Expected Response (200 OK):**

{  
"transactionId": 1,  
"status": "IN_PROGRESS",  
"amount": 100.00,  
"committedAt": "2025-12-22T10:30:00",  
"inProgressAt": "2025-12-22T10:35:00",  
"completedAt": null,  
...  
}

---

Wrong User Tries Action:  
POST [http://localhost:8080/api/transactions/{{transactionId}}/start](http://localhost:8080/api/transactions/{{transactionId}}/start)  
Authorization: Bearer {{customerToken}}  
(Using customer token when only provider should start work)  
**Expected Response (403 Forbidden)**

---

Non-existent Transaction:  
POST [http://localhost:8080/api/transactions/99999/start](http://localhost:8080/api/transactions/99999/start)  
Authorization: Bearer {{providerToken}}  
**Expected Response (404)**

{  
"error": "Transaction not found: 99999"  
}

Provider Completes Work  
**Purpose:** Verify provider can mark work as COMPLETED

POST [http://localhost:8080/api/transactions/{{transactionId}}/complete](http://localhost:8080/api/transactions/{{transactionId}}/complete)  
Authorization: Bearer {{providerToken}}

**Expected Response (200 OK):**

{  
"transactionId": 1,  
"status": "COMPLETED",  
"completedAt": "2025-12-22T11:00:00",  
...  
}
